name: Northlink Fiscal and Capital Services Limited
about: Northlink Fiscal and Capital Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides loans and other financial services in India. The company provides advances and loans to traders, industries, and other educational and social institutions. It also invests in shares/securities, bonds/ IPO, gold, jewelry, and other commodities, as well as malls, schools, colleges, hospitals, old age homes, and nursing homes. In addition, the company offers advisory services to various institutions, such as schools, nursing homes, and dispensaries and community centers. Further, it arranges agencies of brand companies in the field of electronics/electricals, computers and mobiles, and other connected brand items, including various appliances, etc. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
